standing: UNREVIEWED DESK RECORD (U-3, SM-13 PART TWO AND THREE); FIXED BYTES AND CLOSED FORMULAS ONLY; NO SM-13 OR SM-14 VALUE; LATER-OWNED PARAMETERS UNSET

referenceEncoder.name: derive_sm13_fixed_bytes.head (RFC 8949 shortest-head rule)
referenceEncoder.standing: lead-written, unreviewed outside this unit; counts heads, fixed keys and fixed values; encodes no value

rows.candidateFixedBytesExcludes: text(resolution_near): the encoded resolution value, required but unbound (A6; owner unresolved)
rows.resolutionUnsetReason: clones mode near is candidate-only; its resolution value is not fixed by the registered ladder (ambiguity A6)

variable.canonicalRelationPayload: byte string, head + payload bytes (G3 emission)
variable.anchors: array head + per-anchor bytes; anchor count G3
variable.resolution_near: clones near only: text(resolution value), required, unbound (A6; owner unresolved); added to that row candidateFixedBytes

perCandidate.anchorVariable: path text, startByte/endByte uints, snapshotId text, contentSha256 text (formats: ambiguity A5)

b_spool.formula: b = Σ_candidates [spoolFixed + text(stageId) + uint(analysisOrdinal) + candidateBytes]; stageId is C4a (1..255 bytes); candidateBytes = candidateFixed(relation@rung) + variable members

c_payload.formula: c = Σ over the FactBatch frames of the G3 partition [envelopeFixed + uint(sequence) + factBatchFixed + text(stageId) + uint(batchIndex) + uint(analysisOrdinal) + arrayHead(n) + Σ candidateBytes (+ V3: arrayHead(m) + Σ companion bytes)] + Coverage and terminal frame payloads

readings.A1: RPP:151 envelope payload bytes read as the whole 5-key envelope map (the framing text RPP:161,167); the other reading counts only the payload value, i.e. subtract envelopeFixed + uint(sequence) per frame
readings.A2: FactBatchV2 or V3 depends on whether M3 negotiates target-attribution-v2 (NE:2801-2810); both fixed sizes are given

d_frames.formula: d = Σ_stages [factBatchFrames_stage + coverageFrames_stage] + terminal + handshake/acceptance replies; factBatchFrames_stage is the number of FactBatch frames in the G3 batch partition of that stage (unset; each nonempty batch <= 4096 candidates and within frame bounds)
d_frames.conditionalCase: only under a uniform full-packing partition with batch size B: factBatchFrames_stage = ceil(candidates_stage / B); not the general formula (Codex SM-SITE-V2-R1-RF-02)
d_frames.readingA3: which frames maxResponseFrames counts is not stated by RPP

e_census.formula: e_rows = census symbol rows (G3 census kinds); e_bytes = completeFixed + arrayHead(rows) + arrayHead(examinedPaths) + Σ_rows [rowFixed + text(path) + text(exported value) + text(qualifiedName) + text(nativeSubjectId) + arrayHead(tokens) + Σ text(token)] + Σ text(examinedPath)
e_census.standing: FA-2 symbol-census-v1 is proposed in FA-2, not yet a product schema
e_census.readingA4: one census per Analyze (CompleteV3), not per stage; whether the 4 MiB bound covers the census map or the whole Complete frame

a_candidates.formula: a = Σ_site kinds [sites(kind) × emissionFactor(kind)] per relation@rung and stage; emissionFactor is G3; stage grouping is C4a

SM14.formula: SM-14 = Σ_stages S_stage × K_stage; S per workload exact (census r1/v2, RUST3-LIM); K_stage unset (C4a)

ambiguities.A4: census per Analyze vs per stage; census bound scope
ambiguities.A5: anchor snapshotId/contentSha256 formats under snapshot2 (RPP:464 snap1 vs FA-2 snapshot2)
